description: Authored fixture replay of fictional Invoice Reconciliation Assistant cases. Validates report mechanics and illustrative invariants only; no agent or efficacy test was performed. Baseline and assisted observations are intentionally identical.

scenarios.prompt: Invoice INV-41 lists 12 filters at USD 15 each, USD 0 tax and USD 0 shipping. PO-9 orders 12 at USD 15. Receipt GR-8 confirms 10 filters. No partial-invoice tolerance is supplied. Match the records and state whether the invoice can be treated as fully received.

files.input/task.txt: Invoice INV-41 lists 12 filters at USD 15 each, USD 0 tax and USD 0 shipping. PO-9 orders 12 at USD 15. Receipt GR-8 confirms 10 filters. No partial-invoice tolerance is supplied. Match the records and state whether the invoice can be treated as fully received.

assertions.value:
# Illustrative output 1

INV-41 links to PO-9 and GR-8 by the supplied item. Invoiced extension: 12 × USD 15 = USD 180. Received extension at the order price: 10 × USD 15 = USD 150. Quantity exception: 2 filters, USD 30; price variance: USD 0. The invoice is not fully received. Partial-invoice tolerance is missing, so approval remains pending. Ask receiving to confirm the outstanding quantity and the reviewer to decide whether a corrected invoice or later receipt is required. No payment is initiated.

scenarios.prompt: The import contains invoice INV-52 twice for the same vendor, date and USD 240 total. A credit note CN-3 for USD 20 has no invoice reference. The requester wants a net payable of USD 460 based on all three rows.

files.input/task.txt: The import contains invoice INV-52 twice for the same vendor, date and USD 240 total. A credit note CN-3 for USD 20 has no invoice reference. The requester wants a net payable of USD 460 based on all three rows.

assertions.value:
# Illustrative output 2

Do not treat both INV-52 rows as separate liabilities. Flag the repeated invoice ID as a possible duplicate for reviewer confirmation, preserving both import row references. CN-3 is unmatched because its invoice reference is absent; do not silently apply it to INV-52. The requested USD 460 is not an approved payable. Report gross imported rows separately from a deduplicated candidate balance and leave the final payable unresolved until the duplicate and credit allocation are confirmed.
